skill.name: claudeemailskill
skill.description: Guides AI agents through Claude-oriented email prompts, campaign drafts, critique rubrics, rewrite loops, and approval-ready handoffs.
skill.summary: Create reviewable Claude email workflows with clear briefs, QA checks, and approval gates.
skill.author: Sequenzy

security_audit.summary: The reviewed files are prompt-only workflow guidance for email drafting and review. Static analysis reported no findings, and no semantic evidence was found for prompt injection, data exfiltration, executable code, network access, or unauthorized live email actions.

content.value_statement: Email teams need prompts and drafts that stay accurate, reviewable, and safe. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through briefs, critique loops, variants, and approval gates.
actual_capabilities: Builds an email brief with audience, promise, proof, CTA, tone, constraints, and forbidden claims.
Shapes Claude tasks for ideation, drafting, critique, rewrites, variant generation, and final QA.
Asks Claude to tie major claims to bounded source material.
Reviews drafts against relevance, specificity, risk, readability, and production readiness.
Creates handoff packets with subject, preview, body, CTA, and QA notes.
Flags actions that need human approval before live email system changes.
limitations: It does not send email, import contacts, change DNS, or edit production automations.
It depends on the user to provide accurate source claims and audience details.
It cannot verify deliverability, legal compliance, or ESP behavior without external review.
It provides workflow guidance and copy support, not a full email service provider integration.

use_cases.title: Prepare campaign prompt packs
use_cases.description: Turn a campaign brief into structured Claude prompts for drafts, variants, and review notes.

use_cases.title: Audit email drafts
use_cases.description: Review subject lines, preview text, body copy, claims, CTA fit, and approval needs against a clear rubric.

use_cases.title: Create approval handoffs
use_cases.description: Package final copy with QA notes, unresolved risks, and required human reviewers before production work begins.

prompt_templates.title: Build a basic email brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create an email brief for Claude. Include audience, offer, source claims, CTA, tone, constraints, and forbidden claims.

prompt_templates.title: Draft campaign variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to ask Claude for three email variants. Each variant should test a distinct hypothesis and cite the supplied source material.

prompt_templates.title: Critique an existing draft
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to critique my email draft for relevance, specificity, risk, readability, production readiness, and missing approval steps.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a production handoff
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for reviewed campaign work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create an approval-ready packet with final copy, variant rationale, QA notes, unresolved risks, and explicit production blockers.

output_examples.input: A trial-user nurture email needs a clearer CTA and safer product claims.
output_examples.output: The skill returns a focused brief, a revised CTA direction, claim checks, and notes for product or legal review.

output_examples.input: A campaign team needs subject line variants for a webinar invite.
output_examples.output: The skill returns variant goals, subject and preview options, expected audience impact, and review criteria for selecting a winner.

output_examples.input: An agency needs to hand off approved copy to an email operations team.
output_examples.output: The skill returns final copy sections, QA notes, approval owners, and a list of live-system actions that require explicit approval.

best_practices: Provide only the source material needed for the email task.
Ask Claude to connect each major claim to an approved input.
Keep drafting, review, and live email operations as separate steps.
anti_patterns: Do not ask the agent to send email or modify production systems without approval.
Do not rely on Claude to invent customer proof, pricing, guarantees, or compliance claims.
Do not treat minor wording variants as a real campaign test.

faq.question: What does this skill help create?
faq.answer: It helps create Claude prompts, email briefs, campaign drafts, critique rubrics, variant sets, and approval handoffs.

faq.question: Can it send emails for me?
faq.answer: No. The skill separates recommendation from execution and requires explicit approval before live email actions.

faq.question: Does it work with Codex and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code workflows.

faq.question: How should I prepare source material?
faq.answer: Provide approved claims, proof points, audience details, tone examples, CTA goals, and any forbidden language.

faq.question: Can it replace legal or deliverability review?
faq.answer: No. It flags review needs, but legal, product, brand, and deliverability decisions remain human responsibilities.

faq.question: What makes the review process safer?
faq.answer: It checks claims against supplied material and marks actions that need human approval before production changes.
